summary: Iteration 48 (group-aware purchase list) fully tested. Full regression 33/33 passed (v48 + feature + bugfix_45 + seasonal_v46 + perm_v47). Frontend: desktop 1920 column order '#, Item, Order kg, Ag tunch, Lbr Rs/kg, Stock kg, Fine kg, Labour Rs' confirmed, default sort Ag tunch desc (45.4, 28.5, 24.3...), tunch plain numbers (no 'g'), Lbr with Indian commas (Rs 3,11,945), pl-sort-profit_silver_tunch toggles asc(-101.5 first)/desc, pl-sort-item_name sorts alphabetically. Grouped row SNT 40-256 shows x2 badge; dialog shows 'Group members (combined into this row)' with pl-member-0/1 (SNT 40-256 stock 54.291/sold 9.738; SNT-40 PREMIUM stock -14.509/sold 56.750). Mobile 390x844: Item/Order/Ag tunch/Lbr fully visible, td:nth-child(6) right edge = 367px, wrapper scrollWidth == clientWidth (no h-scroll); zoom-out x2 -> 80% (td6 right 306), reset -> 100%, zoom-in caps at 140%. Regression: green checkbox creates then removes the Goods to Arrive entry, Remove temporarily + Refresh restore works, Permanently Deleted Items dialog opens ('No permanently deleted items'). No console errors, no error elements. State left clean.

minor.issue: 222 of 298 rows still show NEGATIVE current_stock_kg (e.g. RING KASTING 65-235 -9.383, CHEKS PANJA 60-070 -5.691, grouped leader KADA-AS 70 -9.83 with both members negative). Grouping fixed only the interchangeable-name cases; the underlying negative-stock cause (opening/as-of baseline seeded lower than sales in the window, order_qty = -stock when variable baseline is 0) is unresolved and is exactly what the user originally reported as 'distorting the list'. Group math itself is correct (leader == sum of members).

issues: Item names truncate quite aggressively at 100px column width (e.g. 'NAJARIYA PLAI...', 'CHITAI BARTA...') - readable but ambiguous for similar item names; zooming out to 80% helps but shrinks text.
Negative Stock kg values render in plain color; consider red styling since negative stock is the user's pain point.

action_items: Decide whether the remaining 222 rows with negative current_stock_kg are acceptable; if not, investigate opening/baseline seeding (baseline_start 2026-01-01 vs as-of inventory at 2025-12-31) because order_qty for those rows is just |negative stock|.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 8493 lines - long-standing violation of the 700-line module guideline; purchase-list endpoints could move into a router module.
Frontend uses the CSS `zoom` property for table scaling; fine on current Chromium/Safari/Firefox 126+, but `transform: scale()` with transform-origin would be more portable.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Snapshot fingerprint format is 'v2:<baseline_start>:<txn_count>:g<groups>:m<mappings>'; opening cache 'v2:<txn>:<anchors>:m<mappings>'. Table td indices on purchase list: 0=green checkbox, 1=#, 2=Item, 3=Order kg, 4=Ag tunch, 5=Lbr Rs/kg, 6=Stock kg, 7=Fine kg, 8=Labour Rs (nth-child is +1). Only 3 multi-member rows exist. Business date 2026-08-19.
rca_of_the_issue: Group-aware caching works as designed: v2 fingerprints include item_groups/item_mappings counts so a group insert forces recompute (verified computed_at moved forward and reverted fingerprint on delete), and the opening cache is stored per member so group edits do not force a heavy as-of inventory recompute. Remaining negative stocks are not a grouping bug: they come from members whose windowed sales exceed the seeded opening stock (e.g. SNT-40 PREMIUM -14.509 kg with 56.75 kg sold in 60d), i.e. an inventory-baseline/mapping data issue upstream of the purchase list.
